The main takeaway from our work is that
the away‐side hadrons associated with a high‐pT photon provide more complete tomography of the dense matter than the away‐side jets.

the NLO pQC D jet tomography can provide a more complete description of the high‐energy dense matter than the leading‐order jet tomography, which is based on the assumption of a universal energy loss.
